data.context: In the 2024 report *Computer implemented inventions: patent trends at IP Australia, EPO and USPTO*, this section examines how the 2014 court decisions affected grant probabilities for computer-implemented invention applications at IP Australia, the EPO and USPTO. It reports a negative effect at IP Australia for applications classified as likely adverse under the patent subject-matter model, and discusses possible explanations for the positive estimates at the EPO and USPTO.
